name: Neon Drift
description: Slide through a neon-soaked city after dark. Master every corner, chase a clean line, and leave the pack in your glow.

name: Shadow Strike
description: A fast tactical adventure where every move matters. Sneak past guards, master your gear, and uncover the city’s secret network.

name: Pocket Puzzler
description: A calming collection of clever little puzzles. Connect the dots, spot the pattern, and give your brain a satisfying workout.

name: Street Hoops
description: Take the court and sink the shot. Build your streak, outplay your rivals, and make the neighborhood court yours.

name: Orbit Runner
description: Dash between tiny planets in an endless cosmic run. Time your jumps, dodge asteroids, and see how far your crew can go.

name: Tiny Tactics
description: Arrange your colorful crew on a compact board and outsmart each new challenge. Small moves make a big difference.

name: Emberfall
description: Fight through a kingdom caught between fire and ice. Chain quick attacks, rescue your crew, and bring the old forge back to life.

name: Clockwork Code
description: Rotate gears, route signals, and solve tidy mechanical puzzles before the clock runs out.

name: Summit Sprint
description: Race up rugged trails, pace your team, and cross the finish line with one last burst of speed.

name: Apex Circuit
description: Tune your ride and take on tight city circuits. Clean turns and smart boosts make every lap count.

name: Wildwood Quest
description: Explore ancient woodland paths, meet curious travelers, and piece together the story hidden beneath the trees.

name: Skybound Relic
description: Sail between floating islands, uncover forgotten ruins, and chart a path to a legendary skyborne relic.

name: Crown & Kingdoms
description: Build a steady realm, manage scarce resources, and outmaneuver rival houses across a changing map.

name: Starfront Command
description: Guide a small fleet through contested space. Plan your routes, protect your outposts, and choose each engagement carefully.

name: Harbor Builder
description: Turn a quiet shoreline into a thriving port. Balance shipping, neighborhoods, and the needs of your growing town.

name: Farmstead Days
description: Plant seasonal crops, care for friendly animals, and shape a peaceful farm one day at a time.

name: Pixel Breakout
description: Keep the ball in play, clear colorful stages, and chase a new high score in this quick arcade challenge.

name: Neon Dash
description: Dodge obstacles, collect light orbs, and keep your streak alive through a lively neon course.

name: Rhythm Rush
description: Tap along to bright beats, hit each note on time, and build a perfect combo through every track.

name: Pinball Galaxy
description: Launch into a cosmic pinball table, hit glowing targets, and keep the bonus multiball going.
